INSERT INTO dependency_health (package, health_score, recency_score, activity_score, security_score, historical_vuln_count, historical_vuln_ids, checked_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, date_trunc('day', NOW()))
ON CONFLICT (package, checked_at) DO UPDATE SET
  health_score = EXCLUDED.health_score,
  recency_score = EXCLUDED.recency_score,
  activity_score = EXCLUDED.activity_score,
  security_score = EXCLUDED.security_score,
  historical_vuln_count = EXCLUDED.historical_vuln_count,
  historical_vuln_ids = EXCLUDED.historical_vuln_ids
RETURNING package, health_score;

GITHUB_BLOCKLIST = {"sponsors", "orgs", "marketplace", "apps"}

def trim_to_repo(url):
    after_domain = url.split("github.com/")[1]
    segments = after_domain.split("/")
    owner = segments[0]
    repo = segments[1]
    return owner, repo

def is_real_repo(owner):
    return owner.lower() not in GITHUB_BLOCKLIST

def extract_github_repo(project_urls):
    github_candidates = [(key, value) for key, value in project_urls.items() if value and "github.com" in value]

    for key, value in github_candidates:
        owner, repo = trim_to_repo(value)
        if is_real_repo(owner):
            return f"{owner}/{repo}"

    return None

github_repo = extract_github_repo(project_urls)
github_url = f"https://github.com/{github_repo}" if github_repo else None

print(github_url)
